quotes.text: You can only use partial authorizations for online card payments.
The issuer and card type determine whether they’re supported.
Displays one of the following authorization statuses: `partially_authorized`, `fully_authorized`, `declined`, or `not_requested`.
In the auto-capture flow, your transaction is automatically captured even if it’s partially authorized.
To disable partial authorizations for increments on a PaymentIntent that has opted for partial authorization, set `payment_method_options[card][request_partial_authorization]` to `never`.

old_evidence.text: You can create a separate PaymentIntent for another form of payment, cancel the entire PaymentIntent, or capture only up to the partially authorized amount.
In the auto-capture flow, your transaction is automatically captured even if it’s partially authorized.
The example requests attempts to increment the PaymentIntent amount to 150 USD from 100 USD, but it’s partially authorized to 135 USD.

findings: The May 11 and November 7 captures document the same online card partial approval feature and remainder choices. The merchant chooses a separate PaymentIntent for another payment, cancellation of the entire Intent, or capture up to the partial approval, and explains the choice to the customer. The guide scopes access to IC+ with sales/support enablement and Visa, Mastercard, Discover and Amex, subject to issuer/card type. The merchant is responsible for laws, regulations and network rules. Amex debit/prepaid, no recurring and no cross-border, and Visa across-card-types language is part of the May 2024 network example within both snapshots. See raw/stripe-partial-authorization-2026.md:8-32 and raw/stripe-payments-partial-authorization-2026-11-07.md:9-33.

The source's main structure is dated correctly and mostly retains documented behavior (wiki/sources/source-stripe-partial-authorization.md:13-47), but its general debit/prepaid shorthand at line 13 and the catalog descriptor (wiki/stripe-index.md:573,708) need to preserve issuer/card dependence and the distinct May 2024 Amex and Visa examples. Also keep the before-capture remainder choice, communications and merchant responsibility in the summary (raw/stripe-partial-authorization-2026.md:10-16, raw/stripe-payments-partial-authorization-2026-11-07.md:11-17), because an integrator asking how to handle the uncovered amount or network restrictions would otherwise lack the explicit decision point and scope in the mapped source.

Latest expanded Charge card details provide partial_authorization.status (partially_authorized, fully_authorized, declined, not_requested), amount_requested and amount_authorized. The opt-in is a request. Its issuer-decline example returns card_declined. The $100-to-$70 manual example shows PaymentIntent requires_capture, zero amount_received and an uncaptured Charge until capture. Under manual capture the Intent amount/amount_capturable bounds the capture, and the successful example then has 7000 received and status succeeded. Under auto-capture the example ends succeeded with only 7000 captured and received. The mapped source wiki/sources/source-stripe-partial-authorization.md:29-43 should expose this operational boundary. Charge authorization, a captured partial amount, full order payment and funds availability are distinct. See raw/stripe-partial-authorization-2026.md:59-131,153-181 and raw/stripe-payments-partial-authorization-2026-11-07.md:52-124,138-168.

The mapped summary's incremental section (wiki/sources/source-stripe-partial-authorization.md:45-47) skips the separate request_incremental_authorization opt-in and confirmed uncaptured eligibility checkpoint. Read incremental_authorization.status=available on the latest Charge before the example increment, keep original partial opt-in inheritance and the explicit never override, and use amount as the desired new total. The example requests 150 USD total after initial 100 USD, approves 35 USD more (135 USD total), and leaves 135 USD capturable and 0 received. Preserve separate capture. See raw/stripe-partial-authorization-2026.md:183-285, raw/stripe-payments-partial-authorization-2026-11-07.md:170-270, and the separate increment guide raw/stripe-incremental-authorization-2026.md:729-745. Apply the two options at their distinct stages so the partial opt-in is not mistaken for enabling incremental authorization itself.

Both captures prohibit overcapture above the partially approved amount, cap the transfer_amount when it exceeds the partial approval on a charge on behalf of a Connect account, and decline below Stripe's minimum. See raw/stripe-partial-authorization-2026.md:26-32 and raw/stripe-payments-partial-authorization-2026-11-07.md:27-33. The source wiki/sources/source-stripe-partial-authorization.md:25-27 retains the boundaries. Preserve the reciprocal overcapture warning at wiki/concepts/stripe-overcapture.md:14-18,41-60 and wiki/sources/source-stripe-overcapture.md:15-19,62-66, where a general overcapture route or allowed percentage does not override this feature's restriction.

November replaces the Node samples with form-encoded curl REST samples for initial manual/auto confirmation, capture and initial incremental-enabled confirmation. Initial creation samples omit the prior explicit payment_method_types=['card'] and include return_url with confirm=true. Those are visible request-example changes, with no statement changing the online-card scope, required payment method fields or feature availability. The standalone versioned Create API describes return_url as optional, used with confirm=true for a return after authentication or cancellation (raw/stripe-api-payment-intents-create-2026-11-07.md:669-670). A return is not authorization, capture, or fulfillment evidence. Compare raw/stripe-partial-authorization-2026.md:38-57,102-108,133-151,191-210 with raw/stripe-payments-partial-authorization-2026-11-07.md:39-50,97-100,126-136,178-189, and tracking/collections/stripe/recollection-2026-11-07-en/pages/dcd8c6cd69dee3ba4c03eb23/content.diff:31-60,88-97,113-141,167-197.

Partial guide prose and examples permit explicit automatic or omission and label the returned capture method automatic in both snapshots (raw/stripe-partial-authorization-2026.md:124-160, raw/stripe-payments-partial-authorization-2026-11-07.md:117-146). The separate November Create PaymentIntent API reference marks automatic_async as default (raw/stripe-api-payment-intents-create-2026-11-07.md:397-413), corroborated by latest-version language (raw/stripe-payments-payment-intents-asynchronous-capture-2026-11-07.md:19-23). Keep the captures and the default conflict scoped. The general default does not establish partial-authorization compatibility with automatic_async, and the sample does not establish equivalence or a universal default. The mapped source's explicit automatic option at wiki/sources/source-stripe-partial-authorization.md:43 is supported and should be paired with a reciprocal qualification if describing omission.

unresolved_questions: Neither partial guide states the API version/account default applicable to its blank capture_method example or verifies partial authorization support under automatic_async. The independent Create API default does not resolve the feature and version combination.
Specific merchant/network eligibility, issuer approval, available balances and settlement were not established.

source_assessments.reason: The November delta is sample-level. The baseline requires clearer remainder handling and status/capture boundaries, separate incremental feature opt-in and confirmed-uncaptured availability checks, and scope for dated network rules and the automatic capture default if omission is discussed.

answers.Q1: Both captures of https://docs.stripe.com/payments/partial-authorization document an IC+ feature for online card payments in which a supporting issuer can authorize less than requested when funds are insufficient. Sales/support enables access and Visa, Mastercard, Discover and Amex support depends on issuer and card type (old raw lines 8-32 and new raw lines 9-33). Decide how to address the remainder and inform the customer. Choices include a separate PaymentIntent, cancellation or capture up to the approved amount. Request if_available on the PaymentIntent, then inspect the expanded latest Charge card details for partial_authorization.status, amount_requested and amount_authorized (old raw lines 34-96 and new raw lines 35-91). The $100 to $70 manual example requires capture and has received zero. Capture can succeed for $70 only, and optional auto-capture can immediately capture the partial amount (new raw lines 93-168). The guide forbids overcapture above partial approval, caps excess transfer_amount for charges on behalf of a Connect account and enforces a minimum. The increment example separately enables incremental authorization and requests a $150 total after $100, with $135 approved and capturable and zero received (new raw lines 170-270). The mapped source-stripe-partial-authorization.md captures the core opt-in and status but leaves out the remainder decision, the authorization-to-capture outcome and the distinct incremental enablement and readiness checkpoints. A partial capture does not settle the unpaid balance or demonstrate funds availability.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/partial-authorization, old raw lines 38-57 and 133-151 show Stripe Node examples, and new raw lines 39-50 and 126-136 use equivalent REST operations through curl, with explicit return_url and the old explicit card method list omitted in the new examples. This sample-level change and JSON and test-table reformatting leave the documented feature flow intact. No universal requirement or payment result follows from a return URL or a syntax change. In source-stripe-partial-authorization.md preserve the May 11 capture and May 2024 Amex and Visa network guidance as dated and maintain the issuer, pricing, merchant responsibility and partial-capture conditions. The earlier and new guides expressly allow automatic or blank in their auto-capture prose (old raw lines 124-160 and new raw lines 117-146). The separate November Create API lists automatic_async as its default. Cross-link the default qualification without assuming omitted capture_method selects explicit automatic or that automatic_async is verified for this feature. Carry reciprocal overcapture and incremental-route qualifications. Partial approval blocks capture above the authorization, and a partial increment is available on a separately opted-in, eligible uncaptured Intent, using a requested total plus an explicit or inherited partial setting (old raw lines 183-285 and new raw lines 170-270). Neither test results nor a succeeded partially captured Intent shows collection of the full order price or available settlement funds.
